description: Illustrations, icons, vectors and clipart for thumbnails, sites, slides and branding.
description_zh: 用于封面、网站、幻灯片与品牌的插画、图标、矢量图与剪贴画。

entries.name: unDraw
entries.description: Open-source illustrations with customizable colors for any project.
entries.description_zh: 开源插画，颜色可自定义，适用于任何项目。

entries.name: Storyset by Freepik
entries.description: Editable, animatable illustrations you can restyle in the browser.
entries.description_zh: 可在浏览器中编辑并做成动画的插画。
entries.notes: Always credit Storyset when using the free illustrations; a Flaticon Premium license removes that requirement.
entries.notes_zh: 使用免费插画时必须署名 Storyset；持有 Flaticon Premium 可免署名。

entries.name: Humaaans
entries.description: Mix-and-match illustration library of people, by Pablo Stanley.
entries.description_zh: Pablo Stanley 的人物拼装插画库。

entries.name: Open Peeps
entries.description: Hand-drawn people illustrations you can assemble into scenes.
entries.description_zh: 手绘人物插画，可自由组合场景。

entries.name: Open Doodles
entries.description: Free sketchy doodle illustrations by Pablo Stanley.
entries.description_zh: Pablo Stanley 的免费手绘涂鸦插画。

entries.name: DrawKit
entries.description: Free and premium illustration packs for products and marketing.
entries.description_zh: 面向产品与营销的免费/付费插画包。

entries.name: ManyPixels Illustration Gallery
entries.description: 2,000+ royalty-free illustrations with color customization.
entries.description_zh: 2,000+ 免版税插画，支持换色。
entries.notes: Cannot be resold or redistributed as stock.
entries.notes_zh: 不得转售或作为图库分发。

entries.name: IRA Design
entries.description: Build your own gradient character and background illustrations.
entries.description_zh: 自定义渐变人物与背景插画生成器。

entries.name: Absurd Design
entries.description: Surreal hand-drawn illustration packs for landing pages.
entries.description_zh: 超现实手绘插画包，适合落地页。
entries.notes: Check the current license terms for attribution rules.
entries.notes_zh: 署名要求以当前许可条款为准。

entries.name: Blush
entries.description: Marketplace of artist-made illustrations with free collections.
entries.description_zh: 画师插画市场，含免费合集。
entries.notes: No credit needed. Not allowed: reselling or redistributing the art, or using it as the basis for merchandise.
entries.notes_zh: 无需署名。但不得转售或再分发插画本身，也不得以其为基础制作周边商品（如直接印在 T 恤上售卖）。

entries.name: SVG Repo
entries.description: 500,000+ open-licensed vectors and icons with license filters.
entries.description_zh: 50 万+ 开放许可矢量图与图标，支持按许可筛选。

entries.name: Iconify
entries.description: Search 200,000+ icons from over 100 open-source sets in one place.
entries.description_zh: 一站检索 100+ 开源图标集的 20 万+ 图标。

entries.name: Feather Icons
entries.description: Minimal, consistent open-source icon set.
entries.description_zh: 极简、风格一致的开源图标集。

entries.name: Tabler Icons
entries.description: 5,900+ free MIT-licensed SVG icons for web and print.
entries.description_zh: 5,900+ 免费 MIT 许可 SVG 图标，网页与印刷均可用。

entries.name: Lucide
entries.description: Community-maintained fork of Feather with active development.
entries.description_zh: Feather 的社区维护分支，更新活跃。

entries.name: Bootstrap Icons
entries.description: Free SVG icon library, usable with any framework.
entries.description_zh: 免费 SVG 图标库，任何框架可用。

entries.name: bioicons
entries.description: Gallery of free open-license icons for science and biology illustration.
entries.description_zh: 科学与生物插画用免费开放许可图标库。
entries.notes: Mixed CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA / MIT — the BY and BY-SA subsets need credit; each icon's license is listed on site.
entries.notes_zh: 混合 CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA / MIT——其中 BY 与 BY-SA 子集需要署名；站内会标注每个图标的许可。

entries.name: Flaticon
entries.description: Icon catalog whose free plan requires attribution.
entries.description_zh: 图标目录，免费档需署名。
entries.notes: Free downloads need attribution; Premium removes it and lifts the free-user cap on edited icons per collection.
entries.notes_zh: 免费下载需署名；Premium 可免署名，并解除免费用户每个合集的可编辑图标上限。

entries.name: The Noun Project
entries.description: Icons for every idea; free downloads require attribution.
entries.description_zh: 万物皆有图标；免费下载需署名。
entries.notes: Free-account downloads require attribution; attribution-free downloads are a Noun Pro benefit.
entries.notes_zh: 免费账号下载需署名；免署名下载属 Noun Pro 付费权益。

entries.name: Icons8
entries.description: Consistent icon, illustration and music families; free tier needs a link.
entries.description_zh: 风格一致的图标、插画与音乐；免费档需挂链接。
entries.notes: Free tier needs a visible link to icons8.com wherever the asset appears — footer, app About/Settings, game credits or the listing.
entries.notes_zh: 免费档需在使用处放置可见的 icons8.com 链接——页脚、App 的关于/设置、游戏 Credits 或商品详情页均可。

entries.name: Heroicons
entries.description: Beautiful hand-crafted SVG icons by the makers of Tailwind CSS.
entries.description_zh: Tailwind 团队手工打造的 SVG 图标。

entries.name: Phosphor Icons
entries.description: Flexible open-source icon family with six weights.
entries.description_zh: 灵活的开源图标家族，含 6 种字重。

entries.name: Iconoir
entries.description: 1,600+ open-source icons.

entries.name: Remix Icon
entries.description: Neutral-style open-source system symbol icons.
entries.description_zh: 中性风格的开源系统图标库。

entries.name: Material Symbols
entries.description: Google's variable icon family, successor to Material Icons.
entries.description_zh: Google 可变图标家族（Material Icons 的继任者）。

entries.name: Magnific (formerly Freepik)
entries.description: Catalog of free vectors, PSDs and photos; the free plan needs attribution.
entries.description_zh: 免费矢量图、PSD 与图片目录；免费方案需要署名。
entries.notes: Renamed from Freepik (2026). Free tier needs a visible 'Designed by Freepik' credit link, 10 stock downloads/day; the pricing page also calls the free plan personal-use-only.
entries.notes_zh: 2026 年由 Freepik 更名而来。免费版需保留可见的「Designed by Freepik」署名链接、每日 10 次素材下载；定价页另称免费版仅限个人使用（与条款口径不一致，商用前请自行核对）。

entries.name: Vecteezy
entries.description: Free vectors and photos with attribution on the free plan.
entries.description_zh: 免费矢量图与照片，免费档需署名。

entries.name: 3dicons
entries.description: Open-source 3D icon library with 5,000+ rendered icons.
entries.description_zh: 开源 3D 图标库，含 5,000+ 渲染图标。

entries.name: Openclipart
entries.description: Long-running community clipart library, everything CC0.
entries.description_zh: 老牌社区剪贴画库，全部 CC0。

entries.name: Simple Icons
entries.description: SVG icons for well-known brands and services, kept on a consistent 24px grid as an open dataset.
entries.description_zh: 知名品牌与服务的 SVG 图标，统一 24px 网格，以开放数据集维护。

entries.name: Octicons
entries.description: GitHub's own interface icons, published as SVGs within the Primer design system.
entries.description_zh: GitHub 自用的界面图标，以 SVG 形式发布于 Primer 设计系统中。

entries.name: Devicon
entries.description: Icons for programming languages, frameworks and developer tools, in plain and wordmark variants.
entries.description_zh: 编程语言、框架与开发工具图标，含纯图形与带字标两种版本。

entries.name: Boxicons
entries.description: Open-source web icon set with regular, solid and logo styles, shipped as SVG and icon fonts.
entries.description_zh: 开源网页图标集，含线性、实心与品牌三种风格，提供 SVG 与图标字体。
entries.license: Icons CC BY 4.0 (attribution waived); fonts OFL 1.1; code MIT
entries.notes: The icons are CC BY 4.0 but the author waives credit: "Attribution is not required but is appreciated." Font files are OFL 1.1, code MIT.
entries.notes_zh: 图标为 CC BY 4.0，但作者明确免署名：「Attribution is not required but is appreciated」。字体文件为 OFL 1.1，代码 MIT。

entries.name: Material Design Icons (Pictogrammers)
entries.description: Community-maintained extension of Google's Material icons, distributed as SVG and icon fonts.
entries.description_zh: 社区维护的 Google Material 图标扩展集，提供 SVG 与图标字体。

entries.name: Font Awesome Free
entries.description: Long-running icon set; the Free tier ships solid, regular and brand styles as SVG and webfonts.
entries.description_zh: 老牌图标集；免费档提供实心、线性与品牌三种风格的 SVG 与网页字体。
entries.notes: Free-tier icons are CC BY 4.0, so credit Font Awesome with a link; the code and fonts are MIT/OFL.
entries.notes_zh: 免费档图标为 CC BY 4.0，需以链接形式署名 Font Awesome；代码与字体为 MIT/OFL。

entries.name: Lucide Animated
entries.description: Animated variants of the Lucide icon set, shipped as drop-in React components and CSS.
entries.description_zh: Lucide 图标集的动效版本，以可直接使用的 React 组件与 CSS 形式提供。

entries.name: SVGL
entries.description: Community-maintained library of brand and technology logos as clean, copy-pasteable SVG.
entries.description_zh: 社区维护的品牌与技术类 logo 库，提供可直接复制的 SVG。

entries.name: Use Animations
entries.description: Free animated icons for web and mobile, delivered as Lottie JSON plus React components.
entries.description_zh: 面向网页与移动端的免费动效图标，提供 Lottie JSON 与 React 组件。
entries.notes: Free files are CC BY unless stated otherwise; commercial use in web and mobile apps is explicitly permitted.
entries.notes_zh: 免费文件除另行说明外均为 CC BY；明确允许在网页与移动应用中商用。

entries.name: typicons.font
entries.description: Open-source interface icon set distributed as a webfont and SVG under a split licence.
entries.description_zh: 开源界面图标集，以网页字体与 SVG 分发，采用双重许可。
entries.license: Fonts SIL OFL 1.1; artwork CC BY-SA
entries.notes: Split licence: font files are SIL OFL 1.1 while the artwork is CC BY-SA, so credit is required.
entries.notes_zh: 双重许可：字体文件为 SIL OFL 1.1，图形为 CC BY-SA，因此需要署名。

entries.name: illlustrations
entries.description: Open-source illustration set of everyday human situations, in PNG and Figma formats.
entries.description_zh: 开源插画集，描绘日常人物场景，提供 PNG 与 Figma 两种格式。

entries.name: OpenMoji
entries.description: Open-source emoji set with 4,000+ icons in SVG and PNG; CC BY-SA 4.0.
entries.description_zh: 开源 emoji 图标集，4000+ 图标，提供 SVG 与 PNG；CC BY-SA 4.0。
entries.notes: Attribution required; derivative emoji collections must keep the same CC BY-SA terms.
entries.notes_zh: 必须署名；改编后的 emoji 集合需以相同 CC BY-SA 条款共享。

entries.name: Game-icons.net
entries.description: 4,000+ free game icons as SVG/PNG, CC BY 3.0; attribution required.
entries.description_zh: 4000+ 免费游戏图标，提供 SVG/PNG，CC BY 3.0；需署名。
entries.notes: Attribution (link to game-icons.net) is required; icons are free for commercial projects.
entries.notes_zh: 必须署名（链接 game-icons.net）；可免费用于商业项目。

entries.name: Noto Emoji
entries.description: Google's open emoji set (Noto Emoji font and PNG/SVG artwork) under the SIL OFL.
entries.description_zh: Google 开源 emoji 集合（Noto Emoji 字体与 PNG/SVG 图形），SIL OFL 授权。
entries.notes: GitHub LICENSE verified as OFL-1.1: free to use and embed including commercially; the font itself may not be sold standalone.
entries.notes_zh: GitHub LICENSE 核实为 OFL-1.1：可免费用与嵌入（含商业）；字体本身不得单独售卖。

entries.name: Twemoji
entries.description: Open-source emoji artwork (SVG/PNG) and libraries; CC BY 4.0 graphics, MIT code.
entries.description_zh: 开源 emoji 图形（SVG/PNG）与相关库；图形部分 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。
entries.notes: Community-maintained fork of Twitter's Twemoji. Artwork requires attribution; the code is MIT.
entries.notes_zh: Twitter Twemoji 的社区维护分支；图形需署名，代码为 MIT。

entries.name: Eva Icons
entries.description: Open-source icon set in outline and fill styles, with SVG, font and framework builds.
entries.description_zh: 开源图标集，含线框与填充两种风格，提供 SVG、字体与框架版本。

entries.name: Ionicons
entries.description: Icon set with iOS and Material styles, as SVG, webfont and framework components.
entries.description_zh: 含 iOS 与 Material 两种风格的图标集，提供 SVG、Webfont 与框架组件。

entries.name: Radix Icons
entries.description: 15x15 icon set drawn on a consistent grid, as React components and SVG.
entries.description_zh: 统一的 15x15 图标集，提供 React 组件与 SVG。

entries.name: System UIcons
entries.description: Icon set for systems and products, distributed as SVG and a webfont.
entries.description_zh: 面向系统与产品的图标集，提供 SVG 与 Webfont。
entries.license: Free use, no attribution (the site's own terms)
entries.notes: The site states its own terms rather than naming a licence: "Use how you want, without attribution."
entries.notes_zh: 站点未指名许可证，而是声明自己的条款：「随意使用，无需署名」。

entries.name: UXWing
entries.description: Icon library with SVG and PNG downloads in several styles, plus an SVG editor.
entries.description_zh: 提供多种风格 SVG/PNG 下载的图标库，内置 SVG 编辑器。
entries.notes: Reselling the icons is not permitted; brand logos and icon names follow a separate section of the licence.
entries.notes_zh: 不允许转售图标；品牌 logo 与图标名称适用许可中的单独条款。

entries.name: Oreo Doodle Icons
entries.description: 197 free hand-drawn SVG icons that draw themselves and wiggle, as plain SVG files or React components.
entries.description_zh: 197 个免费手绘 SVG 图标，会自己画出来并持续轻微抖动，提供 SVG 文件与 React 组件。
entries.notes: The 197 free icons are MIT on GitHub and npm (@oreo-design/doodle-icons); the separate paid Pro set is not part of this entry.
entries.notes_zh: 197 个免费图标在 GitHub 与 npm（@oreo-design/doodle-icons）上以 MIT 发布；另售的 Pro 付费图标不在此条目范围内。
